defs.def: a building in which collections of books, CDs, newspapers, etc. are kept for people to read, study or borrow 图书馆；藏书楼

ex.s: It’s also home to an ancient library.
ex.t: 它还拥有一座古老的图书馆。

ex.t: 一切都感觉自由而轻松。

ex.s: For a few months after the “library” opened, I didn’t bother taking a look, as I had assumed that it would be stuffed full of cheesy love stories.
ex.t: 在这个"图书馆"开放后的几个月里，我没有费心去看一眼，因为我以为里面塞满了俗套的爱情故事。

ex.s: Somewhere in the building, there was also a library, a cafeteria, and a gym.
ex.t: 大楼里的某个地方还有一间图书馆、一个食堂和一间健身房。

ex.s: *Library assistant (Flexible working hours on Monday/Wednesday/Friday)
ex.t: *图书馆助理（周一/周三/周五工作时间灵活）

ex.s: Some instructors choose to put previous test papers on library reserve,  making them available to all students.
ex.t: 一些教师选择把往年试卷放在图书馆 reserve，让所有学生都能借阅。

ex.s: He used to go to the gym or library after delivering students to schools.
ex.t: 他过去常在送完学生去学校后去健身房或图书馆。

ex.s: I have a special place in my heart for libraries.
ex.t: 我心中有一个特别的位置属于图书馆。

ex.s: As I grew older and became a mother, the library took on a new place and an added meaning in my life.
ex.t: 随着我长大成人、成为母亲，图书馆在我生活中有了新的位置和额外的意义。

ex.s: Now, I see my children taking their children to the library and I love that the excitement of going to the library lives on form generation to generation.
ex.t: 现在，我看到我的孩子们带着他们的孩子去图书馆，我很高兴去图书馆的兴奋之情一代代传承下去。

ex.s: As a novelist, I’ve found a new relationship with libraries.
ex.t: 作为一名小说家，我与图书馆建立起了新的关系。

ex.s: I encourage readers to go to their local library when they can’t afford to purchase a book.
ex.t: 我鼓励读者在买不起书时，去当地的图书馆。

ex.s: Encourage readers to use the library.
ex.t: 鼓励读者使用图书馆。

ex.t: 在您的社交媒体上共享图书馆通知 。

ex.t: 图书馆：年轻人的庇护所

ex.s: My Love of the Library
ex.t: 我对图书馆的热爱

ex.s: In a library.
ex.t: 在图书馆。

ex.s: She ran Jackson’s Carnegie Library absolutely by herself.
ex.t: 她独自一人管理着Jackson的卡内基图书馆。

ex.s: You could not take back a book to the library on the same day you’d taken it out; it made no difference to her that you’d read every word in it and needed another to start.
ex.t: 你不能在借书当天就把书还回图书馆；即便你把里面每个字都读了、需要另一本开始读，对她来说也没区别。

ex.s: Fear of the library rules.
ex.t: 对图书馆规则的恐惧。

ex.s: My love of the written word began early as my mother read to me every evening. ___32___ I started reading books on my own before age 5 and my mother took me to the public library once a week to borrow several books.
ex.t: 我对文字的热爱很早就始于母亲每晚给我读书。___32___ 我在5岁前就开始自己读书，母亲每周带我去一次公共图书馆借几本书。

ex.s: It will provide you with access to University facilities such as University Libraries, Sports Centre, and Computing Services.
ex.t: 它将使你能够使用大学设施如大学图书馆、体育中心和计算服务。

ex.s: To enable students to use resources in the library.
ex.t: 使学生能够使用图书馆资源。

ex.s: How to Use a Modern Public Library
ex.t: 如何使用现代公共图书馆

ex.s: Has it been a while since your last ihff to a public library?
ex.t: 你上一次去公共图书馆是不是已经有一阵子了？

ex.s: If so, you may be surprised to learn that libraries have changed for the better.
ex.t: 如果是这样，你或许会惊讶地发现，图书馆已经变得更好了。

ex.s: Some libraries even loan out toys and games.
ex.t: 一些图书馆甚至出借玩具和游戏。

ex.s: If a popular magazine you want isn't offered and the library keeps a list of such requests, they may bring it in when enough interest is shown.
ex.t: 如果你想要的热门杂志没有馆藏，而图书馆保留了这类请求的清单，当显示出足够兴趣时，他们可能会购进。

ex.s: Libraries will often hold reading-group sessions targeted to various age groups.
ex.t: 图书馆经常会举办针对不同年龄段的阅读小组活动。

ex.s: The library may sponsor a language group you could join.
ex.t: 图书馆可能会赞助一个你可以加入的语言小组。

ex.s: Your library might be able to accommodate you.
ex.t: 你的图书馆或许能够满足你的需求。

ex.s: If you want to have a business of your own, your local library can become a launch space for it.
ex.t: 如果你想有自己的业务,你的本地图书馆可以成为它的发射空间.

ex.s: In library bocks and computers, you can find information on starting a business.
ex.t: 如果你想拥有自己的事业，当地图书馆可以成为你的启动空间。

ex.t: 指出公共图书馆的重要性。

ex.t: 强调公共图书馆的重要性。

ex.t: 介绍公共图书馆改进后的服务。

ex.t: 现在阿莉亚等待着战争结束，____和平和一座新图书馆。

ex.s: Librarian and library user.
ex.t: 图书管理员和图书馆用户。

ex.s: His not-for-profit organization runs 100 river boats that serve as floating libraries, schools, and health clinics, and are equipped with solar panels and other communicating facilities.
ex.t: 他的非营利组织运营着100艘河船，这些船作为流动图书馆、学校和诊所运营，并配备太阳能板和其他通讯设施。

ex.s: I checked out a half dozen books on Paul Revere from the library.
ex.t: 我从图书馆借了六七本关于保罗·里维尔的书。

ex.s: I checked out a half dozen books on Paul Revere from the library.
ex.t: 我从图书馆借了六七本关于保罗·里维尔的书。

ex.s: Stories were like air to me and while other kids played ball or went to parties, I lived out adventures through the books I checked out from the library.
ex.t: 故事对我来说就像空气一样，当其他孩子在打球或参加派对时，我从图书馆借阅的书本中体验着冒险。

ex.s: My first job was working at the Ukiah Library when I was 16 years old .It was a dream job and I did everything from shelving books to reading to the children for story time.
ex.t: 我的第一份工作是16岁时在尤凯亚图书馆工作。那是份梦想中的工作，从图书上架到故事时间给孩子们读书，我什么都做。

ex.s: It was a big deal for us to load up and go to the local library, where my kids could pick out books to read or books they wanted me to read to them.
ex.t: 对我们来说，装满东西去当地图书馆是件大事，孩子们可以在那里挑选自己读的书，或挑出想让我读给他们听的书。

ex.s: So two by two,I read library books as fast as I could go: rushing them home in the basket of my bicycle.
ex.t: 所以两本两本地，我尽可能快地读图书馆的书：把它们匆忙放在我的自行车篮子里带回家。

ex.s: Via such, networks, libraries share their books with each other through the use of delivery a rehicles.
ex.t: 它们已经转变为你可以培养求知欲、结识有趣的人或了解如何创业的地方。

ex.s: Her library used to be a  36  place for all who loved books and liked to share knowledge.
ex.t: 她的图书馆曾经是所有热爱书籍,喜欢分享知识的36个场所.

ex.s: The last one standing has just been turned into a “mini community library”: any passer-by can “borrow” a book from its shelves, and return it later, or replace it with another title from their own collection.
ex.t: 最后一个幸存的电话亭刚刚被改造成了一个"迷你社区图书馆"：任何路人都可以从架子上"借"一本书，之后归还，或者用自己的藏书替换。

ex.s: The library is on the left of the playground.
ex.t: 图书馆在操场的左边。

ex.s: You may give your own ideas and / or do further research online or in the library.
ex.t: 你可以给出自己的想法，或者在网上或图书馆做进一步的研究。

ex.s: Go online or to a library to find out how you might investigate them.
ex.t: 上网或去图书馆了解如何研究它们。

ex.s: Do research online or in the library to find out about some of history’s most famous speeches about war and peace.
ex.t: 在网上或图书馆做研究，了解一些历史上最著名的关于战争与和平的演讲。

ex.s: Start a business using the help of your local library.
ex.t: 利用当地图书馆的帮助来创业。

defs.def: a room in a large house where most of the books are kept 图书室；资料室
a personal collection of books, CDs, etc. （书、激光唱片等的）个人收藏

ex.s: Thanks to this ancient library, we now know that goods arrived in Dunhuang from as far away as North-east Europe, and that goods were also exported from Dunhuang across Asia and Europe.
ex.t: 多亏了这座古老的书库，我们现在知道，有来自远至东北欧的商品运到了敦煌，同时也有商品从敦煌出口到亚洲和欧洲各地。

ex.s: My mother was not afraid of Mrs Calloway She wished me to have my own library card to check out books for myself.
ex.t: 我妈妈不害怕Calloway太太她希望我有自己的借书证可以自己借书。

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 馆际互借（ILL）为教师、学生和工作人员提供借阅已借出或本馆未收藏的图书的渠道，以及本馆收藏的文章和书籍章节的数字副本。

ex.s: It takes sentences from its library of documents and prebuilt arguments and strings them together.
ex.t: 它从自己的文档库和预先构建的论据中提取句子并将它们串联起来。

defs.def: a series of books, recordings, etc. produced by the same company and similar in appearance 系列丛书（或录制的音像等）；文库
